content.user_title: Plan UK MTD for Income Tax Preparation
content.value_statement: Sole traders and landlords need to coordinate income checks, digital records, and quarterly reporting obligations. This written guide helps an AI assistant draft preparation materials for review against current HMRC guidance.
actual_capabilities: Provides a written outline for MTD for Income Tax preparation for sole traders and landlords.
Identifies gross trade and property income as inputs for applicability discussions.
Guides drafts of onboarding plans covering software selection and sign-up timing.
Outlines digital record-keeping checklists for trade and property businesses.
Provides an example discussing quarterly reporting deadlines and penalty points.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; the advertised scripts, scheduling engine, decision tree, and templates are not supplied.
Thresholds, deadlines, and penalty explanations require current HMRC verification; no automatic update mechanism is included.
Partnerships, limited companies, trusts, and complex foreign property scenarios are outside the stated scope.
No HMRC submission integration is included, and generated drafts do not establish compliance or replace professional tax advice.

use_cases.title: Prepare a sole trader onboarding plan
use_cases.description: Draft income questions, software selection criteria, and record-keeping actions before confirming the applicable MTD start date.
use_cases.target_user: Sole traders preparing for digital tax reporting

use_cases.title: Organize rental business records
use_cases.description: Create a draft checklist for rental income records and identify ownership details that need professional review.
use_cases.target_user: Individual landlords moving from paper records

use_cases.title: Draft a client readiness briefing
use_cases.description: Outline quarterly reporting preparation, unresolved eligibility questions, and HMRC checks needed before advising a client.
use_cases.target_user: Accountants supporting sole traders and landlords

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Explain the scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain MTD for Income Tax preparation for a sole trader. Distinguish it from VAT and list information needed before assessing applicability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Understand the workflow before sharing financial details.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Draft a record checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a digital record checklist for my rental business using anonymized details: [details]. Flag ownership questions and assumptions needing professional review.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Assess mixed income
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [tax year] and anonymized gross trade and property income [amounts], draft an applicability assessment. Request missing facts and verify current HMRC thresholds.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an assessment across multiple income sources.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Prepare a reporting plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a reporting calendar and onboarding plan for [tax year] using [verified HMRC guidance] and [client facts]. Separate confirmed requirements from unresolved questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a client plan with independently verified rules.

output_examples.input: I have GBP 45,000 consultancy turnover and GBP 10,000 gross rental income. When should I join MTD?
output: Combined stated gross income is GBP 55,000, assuming the rental amount represents your share.
Confirm the tax year, income categories, ownership share, and any applicable exemptions before determining your start date.
Check current HMRC requirements before relying on a mandation date.

output_examples.input: Draft an MTD readiness checklist for my sole trader business.
output: Confirm applicability using the relevant tax year and verified gross income figures.
Review compatible software options and organize digital income and expense records.
Confirm sign-up timing and reporting periods against current HMRC guidance.
Have an adviser review the draft calendar and any uncertain requirements.

best_practices: Confirm the tax year, gross income, and property ownership share before drafting an applicability assessment.
Verify thresholds, deadlines, exemptions, and penalties against current HMRC guidance before acting.
Use anonymized financial summaries and obtain qualified review of generated plans.
anti_patterns: Treating the written guide as installed automation or an HMRC filing service.
Applying the example start date without checking the relevant income year and current rules.
Using the guide for unsupported business structures or complex foreign property cases.

faq.question: What is included in this skill?
faq.answer: This package contains one written SKILL.md guide. Referenced scripts, extension source, and templates are explicitly absent.

faq.question: Does it submit updates to HMRC?
faq.answer: No HMRC submission integration or executable filing workflow is included.

faq.question: Who is the guide intended for?
faq.answer: It addresses sole traders and individual landlords. Partnerships, limited companies, trusts, and complex foreign property cases are outside its stated scope.

faq.question: Are the tax rules automatically kept current?
faq.answer: No automatic update mechanism is included. Verify current thresholds, deadlines, and penalties with HMRC before relying on generated material.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: The written guide can provide context to Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Available integrations depend on your agent environment.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the relevant tax year, anonymized gross trade and property income, and ownership shares. Do not provide credentials or unnecessary personal identifiers.
